feedback: This candidate has not yet been raced, so no telemetry data is available to confirm the effects of the current parameters. The controller uses a base_speed of 1.4, slightly reduced to improve stability and reduce aggressive driving. The derivative gain kd is increased to 3.5 to enhance damping and reduce oscillations. Sensor weights are adjusted to [-1.0, -0.8, 0, 0.8, 1.0], increasing the influence of the inner sensors for better steering precision while maintaining balance. The proportional gain kp remains at 7 and integral gain ki at 0.35 to keep responsiveness and integral correction stable. The geometry is unchanged, which is reasonable given no reported issues. I request telemetry on completion, progress, line_loss_events, rms_error, and steering_oscillation to verify if these changes improve stability, reduce line loss events, and maintain good speed.
